svg.title: Figure 3-SG-03-2. SG-03: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-03-2. SG-03: 29 events (backed 25, by design 1, external 3, unbacked 0); 43 FMEA modes reach SG-03 (in the tree 32, justified 11, tree gaps 0). BE-3.09 (Brake 0x226 not detected (no checksum/counter, GAP-01) AND PCM does not cancel ACC on brake (AOU-03R)) → SWF-005, SWF-006, SWF-008: Corrupted brake-pressed value accepted; worst cause SWF-005.C1 (BRAKE_MODULE (0x226) has no checksum or counter in the vehicle DBC; the RX check ignores checksum, counter and quality and checks timing only; O 3, D 9, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-3.10 (Inactive value check bypassed by mode/param change (e.g. param that selects another brake signal or stock-longitudinal branch, toyota.h:216-248)) → SWF-013: Wrong or permissive safety mode accepted from the host; worst cause SWF-013.C1 (Defect in the reference-build allow-list for 0xdc/0xdf and the car-mode request gate; O 3, D 4, AP L); detection: Host unit tests compiled against the real firmware headers, run by panda CI (test.sh): reference_lock and hw_watchdog, 14 tests, pass at BL-002 locally. Not on target hardware BE-3.13 (SoC sends a positive acceleration while not engaged (QM; its engagement state is fed by the same CAN data)) → SFM-008, SWF-052, SWF-040, SFM-013, SWF-030, SFM-017, SWF-031, SWF-057: Unintended acceleration; worst cause SFM-017.C3 (The envelope accepts stuck or replayed 0x226 (brake) or 0x1D2 (cruise) frames whose content is valid: 0x226 has no checksum and neither has a counter, so a brake press or a PCM cruise release is not seen while the frames keep arriving (GAP-01). At BL-006 the RX timeout is 5 periods (TSR-401) and the reference build refuses or revokes CRUISE_ACTIVE with MAIN_ON = 0 (TSR-405(c)); stuck content is still accepted; O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-3.11 (Gas-pressed signal (PCM_CRUISE.GAS_RELEASED) stuck "pressed": envelope then allows only inactive accel (safe direction) — or stuck "released" while the driver presses: envelope allows accel (longitudinal.h:3-5)) → SWF-017, SWF-006: Item deceleration passed while the driver presses the accelerator; worst cause SWF-017.C1 (Defect in get_longitudinal_allowed (controls_allowed && !gas_pressed_prev) or GAS_RELEASED decoding (0x1D2 bit 4); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements UE-3.12 (PCM adds item accel on top of driver pedal (to verify, AOU-05R)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-05R BE-1.19 (controlsd hang / stale modelV2 used up to ≈3.5 s (GAP-16)) → SFM-006, SFM-037, SWF-040, SWF-043, SWF-033, SWF-072, SWF-078, SWF-080, SWF-081: Lateral command frozen at last value; worst cause SFM-006.C1 (controlsd hangs while card keeps sending the last carControl; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test injects non-finite lateralDelay BE-1.21 (SoC replays an old command buffer (no sequence counter, GAP-10)) → SWF-023: Stale or burst-replayed sendcan frames forwarded to the panda; worst cause SWF-023.C1 (The age gate is 1 s (pandad.cc:78-79). That exceeds the 0.9 s preliminary SG-001 FTTI and is 100 control periods long. The sendcan subscriber is a non-conflated FIFO (pandad.cc:64; services.py sendcan MEDIUM queue), so a backlog of up to 1 s is forwarded in order but back-to-back. No newest-only policy applies per address (WP-W-04 SWF-47, SWSR-411); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-1.22 (Command freshness not supervised: heartbeat shows pandad liveness only; mismatch 3 s, loss 5 s (main.c:182-213; GAP-06, GAP-10) . 2026-10-12, reference build: heartbeat loss revokes at 0.3 s (TSR-407); actuation-frame arrival supervised (TSR-408, opendbc 273f44e); value freshness (TSR-409) open) → SWF-014, SWF-020, SWF-018, DFM-014: Controls withdrawn later than the FTTI after host loss; worst cause SWF-020.C1 (engaged is derived only from selfdriveState alive (<0.1 s), valid and enabled (pandad.cc:424). Neither carControl/sendcan freshness nor the forwarding thread's progress goes into the heartbeat, which is sent from the main thread (pandad.cc:313), so the heartbeat shows pandad and selfdrived liveness only (host side of SWF-014.C2; TSR-409 / TSR-602 not implemented); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-4.19 ((relay stays released; as SG-04)) → DFM-011, SFM-034: Intercept switch stays in pass-through when driven; worst cause SFM-034.C1 (Switch U1 or U2 stuck in intercept, its IN input damaged high or driven high, its pull-down R2/R3 open, or the switches damaged by box supply transients (DG419LE, RR-2026-010); O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: As rated in the DFMEA: no pre-release test of this hardware fault BE-4.20 ((stock 0x343 forwarded while the item transmits; as SG-04)) → SWF-010: Stock camera steering or ACC messages forwarded while the item transmits; worst cause SWF-010.C1 (check_relay flag missing for a replaced message in the TX table, or defect in safety_fwd_hook; O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-4.21 ((relay malfunction detected after 1–2 s, not at all, or cleared by a mode change; as SG-04)) → SWF-012, SWF-090: Relay malfunction not detected; worst cause SWF-012.C1 (Defect in stock_ecu_check, or a replaced message without check_relay; detection starts 1 s after a mode change (safety.h:372-380); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements

Worst cause: highest AP, then highest D. Red: single-point path from the gate logic. Text cut with … is given in full in the figure description.
